 Alpha Diallo, a 29-year-old NBA rookie, joins the Denver Nuggets after honing his defensive skills in Europe. He returns to the Mile High City, where he once lived, aiming to make a significant impact. Diallo was undrafted out of Providence and played five seasons with AS Monaco, earning the EuroLeague best defender title last season. He makes his regular season debut Thursday night at Oklahoma City. Diallo is nearly 10 years older than rookie counterparts AJ Dybantsa of Washington and Utah's Darryn Peterson. But Diallo’s hoping to make just as big of an impact on the floor.
